question: How do I reset my password?

expected_answers.expected_text: To reset your password, go to Settings > Security, click 'Reset password', and follow the emailed link.

gold_evidence.text: Users can reset their password from Settings > Security by selecting Reset password; a reset link will be emailed.

question: What is the refund policy for subscriptions?

expected_answers.expected_text: Subscriptions are refundable within 30 days of purchase if unused.
canonical_answer_variants: Refunds allowed within 30 days for unused subscriptions.
Unused subscriptions may be refunded within 30 days.

gold_evidence.text: Refunds: Subscriptions are refundable within 30 days of purchase when the subscription has not been used.
